balances: mapping(address => uint) token balances

allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]

safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b with require(c >= a)
safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b
safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b with overflow require
safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b
receiveApproval(address from, uint256 tokens, address token, bytes data): external fallback interface implemented by spender contracts
ERC20Interface.transfer(address to, uint tokens): external ERC20 transfer invoked on an arbitrary token address
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance authorization
